title: Long video to clips to scheduled posts

tiktok_privacy.label: TikTok privacy: PUBLIC_TO_EVERYONE, or SELF_ONLY until TikTok audits your app

steps.title: Find clip moments
steps.prompt: Transcript with word times: {{run.dir}}/words.json. Find up to 3 x {{inputs.max_clips}} moments that stand alone as short clips. Write {{run.dir}}/moments.json as a list of items with id, title (the hook), preview (the payoff), reason and status pending, plus src_start and src_end in seconds at word boundaries. Set the output key items to that path.

steps.title: Pick the clips to make
steps.gate_summary: Approve the moments to cut in {{run.dir}}/moments.json and drop the rest, then Continue. Nothing is cut before this.

steps.title: Write the posts
steps.prompt: Clips: {{steps.style.outputs.path}}. Picked moments: {{run.dir}}/moments.json. For each clip and each of {{inputs.platforms}}, write a title, caption and hashtags, and a posting slot in the week from {{inputs.week_start}} as ISO with the Sydney offset. Write {{run.dir}}/posts.json as a list of {clip (the styled mp4 path), platform (one of tiktok, youtube-shorts, instagram-reels), title (2 to 100 characters), caption, hashtags (list, no #), slot} and set the output key posts to that path.

steps.title: Check clips per platform
steps.prompt: Check every clip in {{steps.style.outputs.path}} against {{run.dir}}/posts.json: speaker in frame, captions inside each platform safe zone, no cut mid-word. Write {{run.dir}}/check.md. Set passed to true when nothing is wrong, and list each problem with clip and platform under flags.

steps.title: Approve the posts
steps.gate_summary: Posts and slots: {{steps.copy.outputs.posts}}. Check flags: {{steps.check.outputs.flags}}. Approve to schedule every post in one batch.
